These labels should teach slopes, thresholds, and V1/V2-specific residual structure across several chemical families. Additional loading contrasts target m204, m206, m119, m135, m173, and m216, where loading can otherwise be confused with solvent response. High-tail and model-pathology rows cover m177, m178, m203, and the predicted reversed m23 interval. Novel or low-similarity rows such as m106, m205, m200, m216, and m178 broaden transfer coverage. Together the batch repairs known high-error regions while adding intermediate labels and chemically distinct anchors, which should improve generalization across both ordinary early rows and difficult late or broad Row-distribution regimes."}
